newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity creates asset management and trust firm.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity creates asset management and trust firm.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Tuesday that it formed the Fidelity Asset Management and Trust Company to create products and services for the contractual advice marketplace and personal trust area.
Fidelity also named several appointments to its retail group.

Lynn Davis was named president of the new company, reporting to Paul Hondros, president of Fidelity Investments Retail Group. She was previously executive vice president of Fidelity's Premium Client Development Group, responsible for developing the high-net-worth business.

Among several appointments in the retail mutual fund group, Martha Willis was named executive vice president of the group, responsible for the development and marketing of Fidelity's retail mutual funds. She will report to Hondros.
Willis was previously senior vice president of broker/dealer market management for Fidelity Investments Institutional Services Company.
